paper.title: Dependency-Aware Metamorphic Testing of Datalog Engines
paper.venue: International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis

summary.text: DLSmith applies metamorphic testing to Datalog engines, whose query bugs can undermine the soundness of the program analysers built on them, with potentially serious consequences in safety-critical settings. Compared with existing work, the approach uses rich precedence information capturing dependencies among relations in the program, which the authors say permits considerably more general and effective metamorphic transformations. DLSmith detected 16 previously unknown query bugs across four Datalog engines.
summary.relationship_to_sqlancer: Carries metamorphic query transformation, the basis of SQLancer's oracles, into Datalog engines.
supporting_excerpts: Such bugs, called query bugs, may compromise the soundness of upstream program analyzers, having potentially detrimental consequences in safety-critical settings.
To address this issue, we develop a metamorphic testing approach for detecting query bugs in Datalog engines.
We implement our approach in DLSmith, which detected 16 previously unknown query bugs in four Datalog engines.
